tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page field and panel fill. The background image sits on it.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Tile off, raised panels (the open History row). The poster's own field.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, panel and output borders, navbar rule. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Button, tile-grid and canvas borders; inactive tab underline. Decorative only.

tokens.name: g4
tokens.usage: Decorative grey (3.4:1 on bg): never use it for text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, ghost buttons, placeholders (6.6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Body text, inactive tabs, partner handles (12.6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: bright
tokens.usage: Body text that sits over the network background (landing hero).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, tile on, the page frame, stage-card border, primary text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single signal: active tab, primary button, stage/section labels, filled output. Nothing decorative.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Selected fills (reserved for future selected states).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero title only (36px on phones).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Draw a digit (0–9) on the 3×5 grid, then click Recognize.
styles.usage: Body copy, output text, partner names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings and inside panels.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Navbar wrap gap, phone panel padding.

tokens.name: s9
tokens.usage: Hero top and page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons only. Every other surface (tiles, canvas, cards, panels) is square.

tokens.name: frame-inset
tokens.usage: Distance of the white page frame from the viewport edge (8px on phones).

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Page frame stroke. Stage cards use half of it (1px).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Button height: the minimum touch target.
